description: Get the beers a brewery makes, by brewery id, with per-beer rating and check-in counts. Supports sorting and paging. Get an id from untappd_search_brewery. Read-only.

view.description: Response shape: "compact" (default) drops fields the response already carries elsewhere; "full" returns every field this server understands. compact keeps each beer's identity, rating and counts and drops the description, label URLs and the copy of this brewery repeated on every row; "full" returns Untappd's whole page.

name: untappd_brewery_beers
title: Get a brewery's beer list
